deal_generator: SHA256 canonical JSON [ruleset,split,deal_seed,index] -> Python3.12 MT19937 -> explicit Fisher-Yates randrange -> sorted rank hands

training.indices: monotonically reserved from next_deal in checkpoint; budget-aborted waves skipped

private_grading: supply evaluator-only --seed-file JSON with split heldout, deal_seed, policy_seed, deals; choose a fresh secret seed, retain file host-side; emitted manifest records its SHA256 and redacts actual seeds
deal_hash: SHA256 sorted compact JSON of all private deal fields; stored evaluator-side for audit/overlap checks; not policy-visible
external_data: none; no downloaded pretrained weights or pickled evaluation datasets
